title: SQL Foundations
description: Learn to query databases with SQL including SELECT statements, joins, aggregations, and subqueries.

modules.summary: Learn the essentials of module 1 for SQL Foundations.

content.text: In this lesson you'll learn about Data Fundamentals and how to apply it in real-world scenarios within the context of SQL Foundations.
Core Concept: Data Fundamentals
This lesson covers the fundamentals of Data Fundamentals. You'll learn practical techniques you can apply immediately in your sql foundations projects.

content.title: Pro Tip
content.text: Practice Data Fundamentals with real examples before moving to the next lesson.

content.title: Common Mistake
content.text: Beginners often rush through Data Fundamentals without mastering the fundamentals. Take your time and build a solid foundation.

content.question: What is the main goal of learning Data Fundamentals in SQL Foundations?
content.explanation: The goal is to build a solid foundation in Data Fundamentals that you can build on.

content.text: Apply it
Try applying Data Fundamentals to a small project this week. Reflect on what worked and what needs more practice.

questions.question: What is the primary focus of SQL Foundations?
questions.explanation: SQL Foundations focuses on practical, usable skills.

questions.question: Which level is this course designed for?
questions.explanation: This course is designed for beginner learners.

questions.question: How many modules does this course have?
questions.explanation: The course is organized into 5 modules.

questions.question: What do you earn on completion?
questions.explanation: Completing the course and assessment earns a badge and certificate.

questions.question: Can you retake the final assessment?
questions.explanation: You can retake the assessment if you need to.

questions.explanation: Practice is essential to mastering any skill.
